pages.text: Fleshbinding is a powerful technique whereby a mob can be bound into item form called an $(bold)idol$().$(br2)This $(italic)only$() works on mobs that have been sufficiently weakened (brought to 10 or less health). To release a mob from a fleshbinding, simply use its idol like a spawn egg.
Four pig idols in a diagram.

To perform a Fleshbinding, you will need four items. $(br)1. An item that the mob might drop (or one of its mob transfusion results).$(br)2. The $(l:otherverse:items/resources)Prime$() of your current dimension (salt for Overworld, sulfur for Nether, quicksilver for End, cinnabar elsewhere).$(br)3. A tiny bit of power from any source, such as Self or an idol.

The fourth item will become the idol's $(bold)material$(), which affects how it functions when placed in an item focus. A tier 1 idol made from logs or planks functions as a living bound mob, but cannot be healed and is drained with 1/3 efficiency. Lapis idols can be healed. Diamond idols can also be healed, and are as efficient as a living mob.

pages.title: Cinnabar Idols
pages.text: You can right-click a cinnabar block on any already-bound mob to trap the mob in the block for easy transport. These idols cannot be used in diagrams; the mob will be released automatically if the idol enters an item focus.$(br2)You will get the cinnabar block back when you release the mob.
